requirements.title: Procedure references invoke the actions specified by the procedure
requirements.definition: The actions specified by a procedure are performed once the procedure is invoked by executing a reference to it.

requirements.title: Procedure actions access entities through argument association
requirements.definition: The sequence of actions encapsulated by a procedure has access to entities in the procedure reference through argument association.

requirements.definition: A name in a dummy-arg-name position of a SUBROUTINE, FUNCTION, or ENTRY statement is a dummy argument; intrinsic procedures and intrinsic-module procedures specify dummy arguments in Clauses 16, 17, and 18.
